subject: CHE
title: Introduction to Chemical Engineering
description: Overview of the chemical engineering profession. Mass and energy balances, units and dimensions, process variables, and introduction to process flow diagrams.

subject: CHE
title: Engineering Biology
description: Molecular and cellular biology concepts relevant to chemical engineering: biomolecules, enzymes, metabolism, and genetic regulation.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Engineering Computation
description: Numerical methods and scientific computing for chemical engineering applications: linear/nonlinear systems, ODEs, optimization.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics 1
description: First and second laws, properties of pure substances, thermodynamic cycles, and applications.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Engineering Fluid Mechanics
description: Fluid statics, laminar and turbulent flow, piping systems, dimensional analysis, and turbomachinery.

subject: CHE
title: Heat and Mass Transfer
description: Conduction, convection, radiation; molecular diffusion and convective mass transfer; design correlations and applications.

subject: CHE
title: Transport Processes 1
description: Unified treatment of momentum, heat, and mass transport with differential balances and constitutive relations.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Reaction Engineering
description: Homogeneous and heterogeneous kinetics; design of ideal reactors; non‑ideal flow; multiple reactions; catalysis concepts.

subject: CHE
title: Process Control
description: Dynamic modelling; feedback control; stability; frequency‑domain analysis; controller tuning; multivariable control.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Process Design
description: Flowsheet synthesis, equipment sizing, costing, economics, safety and environmental considerations; capstone design planning.

subject: CHE
title: Advanced Chemical Reaction Engineering
description: Advanced reactor analysis including multiphase reactors, residence‑time distributions, and catalytic systems.

subject: CHE
title: Advanced Transport Phenomena
description: In‑depth momentum, heat, and mass transfer with boundary layers and turbulence; advanced applications.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics 2
description: Thermodynamics of mixtures, phase and chemical reaction equilibria, equations of state, activity coefficient models.

subject: CHE
title: Biochemical Engineering
description: Kinetics of enzymes and cells, bioreactor design, mass transfer in bioreactors, fermentation and downstream processing.

subject: CHE
title: Polymer Engineering
description: Polymerization mechanisms, characterization, rheology, and polymer processing operations.

subject: CHE
title: Process Safety Engineering
description: Hazard identification, consequence analysis, risk assessment, and safety management systems for process industries.

subject: CHE
title: Green Engineering
description: Sustainable process design, green chemistry principles, life‑cycle assessment, and pollution prevention.

subject: CHEM
title: General Chemistry 2
description: Liquids and solutions; chemical equilibria; acid–base equilibria; solubility; electrochemistry; chemical kinetics.

subject: CHEM
title: Introductory Spectroscopy and Structure
description: Electromagnetic radiation, quantum ideas; microwave, IR/Raman, UV‑Vis, photoelectron, and NMR spectroscopy for structure determination.

subject: CHEM
title: Structure and Bonding
description: Atoms and periodicity; localized bonding; symmetry and group theory; molecular orbital theory with inorganic examples.

subject: CHEM
title: Intro Analytical Chemistry
description: Quantitative analysis, ionic equilibria, classical and instrumental methods; planning and decision‑making in analysis.

subject: CHEM
title: Multi‑Component Analysis
description: Instrumental analysis with emphasis on multicomponent systems; chemometrics and data handling.

subject: CHEM
title: Fundamentals of Biochemistry
description: Biomolecules and representative proteins/enzymes; intro to metabolism.

subject: CHEM
title: Introductory Biochemistry
description: Chemistry of amino acids, carbohydrates, lipids, nucleic acids; protein structure and enzymes.

subject: CHEM
title: Introductory Chemical Thermodynamics
description: First, second, third laws; ideal systems and mixtures; equilibria; phase changes; equilibrium constant relations.
prerequisites: CHEM 123 or CHEM 125; plus required math

subject: CHEM
title: Organic Chemistry for Engineering
description: Foundations of organic chemistry for engineering students; functional groups, structure, and reactivity.

subject: CHEM
title: Organic Chemistry 1
description: Structure/bonding, stereochemistry, acidity, mechanisms; alkanes, haloalkanes, alcohols/ethers, alkenes, alkynes.

subject: CHEM
title: Organic Chemistry 2
description: Carbonyl addition/substitution, aromaticity and aromatic substitution, spectroscopy applications.

subject: CHEM
title: Basic Organic Chemistry 1
description: Structure, nomenclature, stereochemistry, and mechanisms across major functional groups.

subject: CHEM
title: Basic Organic Chemistry 2
description: Continuation of CHEM 266: amines, aromatics, enols/enolates, carbonyl chemistry; intro to NMR and IR.

subject: CHEM
title: Transition Element Compounds and Inorganic Materials
description: Coordination chemistry, organometallics, and transition‑metal solids: structure, bonding, properties, and catalysis.

subject: CHEM
title: Main Group and Solid State Chemistry
description: Electronic structure models; crystallography basics; structures of simple solids; main‑group descriptive chemistry.

subject: CHEM
title: Analytical Instrumentation
description: Selected instruments and methods; chemometrics; computer interfacing.

subject: CHEM
title: Metabolism 1
description: Metabolism of carbohydrates, lipids, and amino acids; regulation and bioenergetics.
prerequisites: One of CHEM 233, 237, NE 224; and CHEM 265 or 267

subject: CHEM
title: Introductory Computational Chemistry
description: Foundations and applications of molecular modelling; hands‑on computational labs using common software.
prerequisites: Level at least 3A plus required background

subject: CHEM
title: Chemical Kinetics
description: Rate laws, complex mechanisms, fast reactions; statistical mechanics foundations; reaction rate theory.

subject: CHEM
title: Introductory Quantum Mechanics
description: Wave mechanics: particle in a box, harmonic oscillator, rigid rotator, hydrogen atom; approximation methods.

subject: CHEM
title: Physical Biochemistry
description: Diffusion, ultracentrifugation, osmotic pressure, electrophoresis, X‑ray diffraction; enzyme kinetics and regulation; selected spectroscopies.
prerequisites: CHEM 123/125, MATH 128; and one of CHEM 233, 237, NE 224

subject: CHEM
title: Organic Chemistry 3
description: Enolates and carbonyl chemistry; pericyclic reactions; frontier MO theory; organometallics; transition‑metal‑catalyzed C–C formation.

subject: CHEM
title: Introduction to Polymer Science
description: Polymer nomenclature and molecular weight; polymerization mechanisms; chain conformations; glass transition and crystallization; mechanical behaviour.

subject: CHEM
title: Special Topics in Biochemistry
description: Selected topics in biochemistry; content varies by offering.
prerequisites: CHEM 331 or CHEM 333; level at least 3A

subject: CHEM
title: Metabolism 2
description: Porphyrins, purines, pyrimidines, and biogenic amines; cofactors; enzyme structure‑function; metabolic regulation.
